title: Tape change and the St. Louis hotel stay
summary: Back to St. Louis: the trumpeters wiped him out every Sunday, and he lived in the hotel attic for weeks.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Where were we? We was talkin' about somethin'.
Talking about blues and ballads and, you know...
Oh, we were in St. Louis, and all the trumpet players used to gang up on you...
Every Sunday they'd come in, and wipe me out every Sunday -- Sunday afternoon.
Yeah. It was in a hotel. I can't think of it, the Grand something...
How long did you stay there?

Oh, I don't know. I must have stayed there about three weeks or so, two or three weeks, maybe four. It may have been a month, you know. We stayed there long enough that when they put us out of the room... We were staying upstairs in the attic of the hotel, so you know we was in bad shape! That's when I got the job with this other carnival, Beckman and Worthen...
